discrepancy.note: Strauss shows Luke's Quirinius census could not have coincided with Herod's reign, since Quirinius only became governor of Syria years later.

quotes.text: it is an authenticated point that the assessment of Quirinus did not take place either under Herod or early in the reign of Archelaus, the period at which, according to Luke, Jesus was born. Quirinus was not at that time governor of Syria
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined (1846), § 32, The Census, on Matthew 2:1 and Luke 2:2.
